Divergence 1.5.1 (81)

  • Macs can connect to each other again. A secure connection between two Macs could fail every time, reporting the other machine as offline or not paired when it was neither. Both machines were identifying themselves correctly — Divergence was comparing the two forms of the same identifier as though they were different machines.
  • If one Mac is updated and the other is not, connections between them start working again as soon as either side is on this version.

Divergence 1.5.1 (80)

  • Connection failures now say what went wrong. When a secure connection to another Mac failed, Divergence reported “offline or not paired” regardless of the real cause — including for problems it had already detected. It now names the specific failure, on screen and in the logs.
  • Refresh devices. A new button in the toolbar re-reads your device list, so a machine you removed or re-added shows up without restarting Divergence.

Divergence 1.5.1 (79)

  • Connections recover faster when a Mac changes networks. Moving between Wi-Fi networks — or on and off a phone hotspot — could previously leave a Mac looking reachable for up to a minute after it was not, so anyone trying to connect to it in that window was turned away. It now notices the change straight away and re-establishes itself on the new network.
